comparison.objective: Pick a clear training lock using coordinated tension and pin setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain plug torque while sequentially setting spring-loaded pins with a hook; the candidate instead stabilizes a coaxial mandrel for discrete impacts and later collects fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Three pins set, plug turned to the open mark, and both tools withdrawn.
comparison.reason: This is the closest precision two-tool comparison, but it tests binding-pin feedback and lock rotation, not notch fracture, retained-coil protection, or debris containment. No spec versions or numeric torque thresholds are supplied.
